title: Logical tokens are not physical memory
purpose: Distinguish valid state, reserved capacity and shared allocation ownership before adding bytes.
contract: Formula assumes uniform dense K,V tensors; b is stored bytes per element.
The shared-block fixture has 2 tokens per block; each block contains 64 bytes.
Category widths are not proportions. No device capacity or performance is implied.
